Resolves #19762

A buffered list now declares its silent pooled re-bind dense. `getPooledComponent` sets `denseUpdate = true` beside the depth it raises, so a row update that merges into the repaint can no longer hand the payload an allow-list that prunes every other re-bound row. This is the contract `grid.View` already keeps (#18719).

Evidence: L3 (unit spec through the real update cycle, plus a local throttled-browser probe of the failing consumer journey) → L3 required for AC-1–AC-3. Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#596.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR body, commit authorship, and unit jobs ran.

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The spec reproduces the defect class through the interleaving of the #18719 precedent: the first repaint is in the air, a row update waits behind it, then a scroll re-binds the pool. The observed consumer path, an idle list whose payload goes sparse on an empty merged set, is covered by the throttled probe below.

## Test Evidence
Red on the merge-base source: the probe row merged into the repaint, and rows 1–8 kept stale vnodes.
```
Error: every re-bound row reached its vnode
+   "list-buffered-test-1__1__component: vnode Record 19, record Record 49",
…   (rows 2–7 alike)
+   "list-buffered-test-1__8__component: vnode Record 26, record Record 56",
```
Consumer journey, neomjs/neo-agent-institution#703's `FleetActivityObserver.spec.mjs`, under 6× CPU throttling (CDP `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate`): without the line it failed 6/6, with every row's vdom ahead of its vnode and the DOM. With the line patched into the Engine copy it passed 4/4, with vdom, vnode and DOM agreeing.
